notes.title: Ingram Valley Update
notes.content:
🗺️ Big Update! Explore Tynedale Like Never Before...

Adventurers, welcome back!
Our latest update brings one of the most exciting features yet to The Legends of Tynedale—a fully functional overworld map to help guide you through the lands you’ve come to know (and maybe get lost in).

Whether you’re diving into ancient dungeons or retracing your path through forgotten forests, this new feature transforms the way you explore!



🆕 A True Explorer’s Map

With this update, every step of your journey is tracked—giving players a clear, yet immersive way to see the world of Tynedale unfold.

Uncover the world as you go: see where you’ve been and what remains mysterious

Find key locations, secrets, and side paths at a glance

Keep track of your main objective with subtle reminders built into the map

It’s all designed to keep the spirit of exploration alive—without losing the magic of discovery.



 Fixes, Tweaks & Polish

We’ve also been hard at work improving the game’s stability and polish based on your feedback:

Cherryburn Farm burn bush no longer needs re-burning

D3 gates now animate and behave correctly

Fixed bug where “Treasure C” could re-lock after opening

Resolved item reveal issues in the Cheviots and Dungeon 4

Removed random reveal sound in D4

Push block puzzle in Dungeon 3 updated

Fixed Blanchland pot behavior

Amble Water now correctly returns you to the overworld

Underground stairs near Blue House (Gosforth) repaired

Fixed bug that could warp you to random spots when entering buildings



🎨 Visual Enhancements

You’ll also notice some subtle but atmospheric improvements in underground areas—designed to make those hidden depths feel darker, richer, and more immersive.



🎮 Already playing? Jump back in and discover the difference.
🧭 New to Tynedale? There’s never been a better time to begin your journey.

Thank you for continuing to support and share the game—it means the world.

– Tom / Developer of The Legends of Tynedale

notes.title: Hexham Ruins Update
notes.content:
Warriors of Tynedale, 

One of my biggest updates has dropped, again focusing on the quality of the game and the fun:

Gameplay:
-	New puzzle in Hexham Ruins
-	Area redesigns for Longsands Beach, Kielder Forest and Dunstanburgh Castle, including more enemy placements and variations, vegetation placement and challenge
-	More pots and enemies in Dungeon 2 and 4

Enemies:
-	Two more monsters have slipped into the world, well hidden under bushes, pots and rocks. One will hunt you down, the other is a little lazier but will still jump out at you … boo!

World Building:
-	Well, since I created the world, I thought I’d move in … if you can find me!
-	A variety of food and drink items have been delivered, celebrating the great traditions of Tynedale
-	More books around Tynedale, available if you want to dive deeper into the world of Tynedale

Graphical and animation updates too:
-	New bridge designs in Gosforth – courtesy of a little charity fun run and our resident stone mason laid the foundations
-	Ladder climbing animations – instead of running down, you’ll climb … ‘elf and safety ‘n’ all dat.
-	UI improvements and changes for better player feedback
-	Smoke particles for them chimneys and camp fires 

Sound FX:
-	Water falls sound like … water falls rather than silent … things
-	There are a range of pots smash and bush chopping sounds
-	Cleaned up some sounds sounding when shouldn’t 

Bugs Fixes:
-	Various small bugs splattered, including some collisions and enemy respawning

Finally, unbelievably, it is Tynedale’s Two-Year Anniversary! Happy Birthday, Tynedalers! Thank you for your incredible support!

notes.title: Great Park Update
notes.content:
Welcome, Intrepid Adventurer!

Another update for you, you legends of Tynedale! This one is mostly focuses on improving the quality-of-life of the game:
-	 New artwork updates and numerous graphical fixes and been sprinkled across the land. 
-	There’s also been a major coding update to the health system that had created a game breaking but we squashed the critter! Splat! 
-	New particle effects added too, making the world feel even more lived in.
-	A FPS options has been added
-	Other incidental bug fixes too, mostly around player interactions that had been accidentally removed during a programming update
-	Camera fixes, including in and around Druid Bay
-	More enemy placements – go get ‘em, Tiger!

Thank you for all the support!

notes.title: Ford & Etal Update
notes.content:
Hello, Adventurer,
 Another big update for the Legends of Tynedale is here! 

Dungeons: 
-	new rooms have been added to the Ashington Mines
-	the Laidly Worm of Spindleston Heugh has had a wrist slap (or tail!) for being too aggressive (naughty!)
-	there has been some design and puzzle refinement as well

Tynedale: 
-	gate guards are now animated when opening the gate
-	another underground cave can be found.  More food options (yum!)
-	all gravestones have a story to tell. New graphical updates, refinements and font corrections

Audio Improvements: 
-	low health sound plays to warn the player if health very low
-	more sounds for enemies, such as bursting out of walls or water

More Tips, Secrets and Lore: 
-	added to the ‘Book of the Unexpected’ in the library and loading screens

Bug squashing (stomp!):
-	pressure switches would sometimes ‘unpressure’ despite a weight on top - fixed
-	extendable enemy moves smoother
-	extendable enemy graphical update
-	corrected music for some underground rooms
-	bool not loading correctly for one underground puzzle - fixed

notes.title: Edlingham Update
notes.content:
Tynedale Traveller!

The Edlingham Update is here. This update includes much enrichment of the the world of Tynedale, including new assets, graphical updates, animations and sounds.

You can also rebind your keys if playing on the keyboard or you can use the gamepad.

More details below:

UX
-	Keyboard Rebinding options now available
-	Buttons change reference if controller inserted or removed 
-	New scene transition animations
-	New title screen animations
-	New Pandora’s box animations
-	New Tips and Lore on screen transition

Major Graphical Updates:
-	New building models
-	Walk under gates and house entrances
-	New assets and graphical changed

Bug Fixes:
-	Player can be hurt by other projectiles while falling to death – fixed
-	Player can pass through fall2Death after dying - fixed
-	Many other quality-of-life improvements

notes.title: Corbridge Update
notes.content:
Adventurers!

The Corbridge update has dropped. Tynedale has been invaded by new enemy because, you know, there aren’t enough things trying to kill you. In fact, many places and spaces have had more enemies invade them. So, get your sword out and smashy, smashy! Tread carefully in Kielder Forest as the places is shrouded in low clouds.

The band has got together to create more music and add more sounds: dungeons, UI and the world all feeling the groove. The UI has had some love and care. There are new colours, backgrounds and animations. Gamepad users can use the shoulder buttons for easy inventory screen swapping. Screen resolution options have been added too.

Come and join the Discord and chat to me, the developer, and meet awesome fellow adventures: https://discord.gg/yBmYJgU

Here’s a quick recap:
-	New extend enemy
-	More enemy placements 
-	Clouds in Kielder Forest and the Cheviots
-	New soundtracks added to dungeons 
-	New backgrounds and colours for inventory menus
-	UI navigation sounds 
-	UI graphic updates are more consistant
-	UI animates item selection
-	UI new dialogue display 
-	Gamepad shoulder buttons swap panels
-	Screen resolution

notes.title: The Alnwick Update
notes.content:
Tynedalers,

I'm excited to announce the Alnwick update is here! I have been busy listening to feedback and working on improving the game. There are loads of new features to add to the experience, from achievements to more effects in the game! Enjoy!


New Features: 

- rainfall to Allen Banks
- a windy storm at the top of the Cheviot mountains
- sandstorms in Blanchland
- achievements (10)
- animation to all dungeon doors
- animation to inventory selection (pops on selection)
- animated wall torches and candles
- animated hookshot use
- animated fire ring use
- more particle effects to secrets and reveals. Bombs too.
- developed Cragside, adding in another puzzle
- fireballs burning through grass
- more sound effects, eg rain, flames, weapon noises
- additional bug fixes

Join the friendly, chilled Discord community: https://discord.gg/yBmYJgU: chat directly to the developer, make suggestions and meet awesome fellow adventures!

Alnwick Update v1.12
